name: claude
title: Claude Code
summary: Preset CLI and legacy cleanup. Hook wiring arrives with the plugin, not this script.
installer_note: Writes the adw-judge preset CLI under the state directory. The plugin carries every hook.
writes: ~/.claude/settings.json, to remove legacy watcher hooks only
~/.claude/plugins/cache/agent-discipline-watcher, cleared then reinstalled by the claude CLI
reclaims: ~/.local/bin/adw-judge, only when it still points into this checkout
~/.zshrc and ~/.bashrc, only the fenced PATH block an earlier install appended
